newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Swedish employers want early EMU entry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish employers want early EMU entry.

text.p: The Swedish Employers' Confederation, SAF, said on Thursday it supported early Swedish entry to European economic and monetary union.

"Regardless of when our government thinks Sweden should join the EMU, Swedish companies will adapt to the new circumstances and use the euro from the beginning," SAF chairman Anders Scharp said in a news release following a meeting with European Commission President Jacques Santer.
Scharp said there were many advantages with monetary union.
"It will help speed up the implementation of the internal market, strengthen European competitiveness and support a more stable financial environment in Europe," he said.
The Swedish parliament will decide this autumn whether Sweden should join EMU.
During the meeting with Santer, Scharp said he had made a number of observations on the need to boost the competitiveness of the European Union, restructuring of European industries and stable rules.
